criterion: which COVID-19-related user intent the utterance expresses

categories.name: Information Sharing
categories.definition: Utterances expressing a desire to share COVID-19 related information on social media or with others.

categories.name: Seeking Information
categories.definition: Utterances seeking information or updates about COVID-19, such as news, symptoms, prevention, or treatment options.

categories.name: Travel Concerns
categories.definition: Utterances related to travel safety, restrictions, and concerns during the COVID-19 outbreak.

categories.name: Myth Debunking
categories.definition: Utterances seeking clarification or debunking of myths or misinformation related to COVID-19.

categories.name: Donations and Support
categories.definition: Utterances related to donating money, supplies, or support to COVID-19 relief efforts or affected areas.

categories.name: Symptom Inquiry
categories.definition: Utterances inquiring about COVID-19 symptoms, transmission, or effects on different surfaces or animals.

categories.name: Prevention Measures
categories.definition: Utterances seeking information on preventive measures, such as wearing masks, hand hygiene, social distancing, and cleaning practices.

categories.name: Vaccine Inquiry
categories.definition: Utterances inquiring about the development, availability, or safety of a COVID-19 vaccine.

categories.name: Treatment Options
categories.definition: Utterances seeking information on treatment options, medications, or remedies for COVID-19.

categories.name: Community Spread Concerns
categories.definition: Utterances expressing concerns about community spread, infection rates, and transmission of COVID-19.

categories.name: Animal Related Inquiries
categories.definition: Utterances inquiring about the transmission, risks, or effects of COVID-19 on animals.

categories.name: Government Regulations
categories.definition: Utterances seeking information on government regulations, restrictions, or guidelines related to COVID-19.

categories.name: Appreciation and Feedback
categories.definition: Utterances expressing gratitude, appreciation, or feedback for COVID-19 related information or services.

categories.name: Fear and Anxiety
categories.definition: Utterances expressing fear, anxiety, or emotional distress related to COVID-19.

categories.name: Misinformation Concerns
categories.definition: Utterances expressing concerns about misinformation, fake news, or myths related to COVID-19.

categories.name: Workplace Safety
categories.definition: Utterances seeking information on workplace safety, protocols, or precautions during the COVID-19 outbreak.

categories.name: Global Statistics Inquiry
categories.definition: Utterances seeking information on global COVID-19 statistics, case counts, recovery rates, or outbreaks.

categories.name: Household Cleaning Practices
categories.definition: Utterances seeking information on cleaning practices, disinfection, or sanitization of household items and surfaces.

categories.name: Social Distancing Guidelines
categories.definition: Utterances seeking information on social distancing guidelines, practices, or recommendations.

categories.name: Healthcare Worker Concerns
categories.definition: Utterances expressing concerns or seeking guidance for healthcare workers, essential workers, or frontline workers during the COVID-19 outbreak.
